name: Dont You Know Who I Work For

boon.description: It's funny. Your target knows the person, but they’ve never heard your name mentioned.

conservative.requirements: Target must be able to hear you, the person you mention must be important (a big name)

success.description: You drop a name. A big name. This can be an employer or even an acquaintance. If appropriate, you influence the target. At the very least, you now have his full attention.
The target adds {De} to all Social actions with you as a target.

boon.description: While this card is recharging, your target adds {De} to all Social actions with you as a target.

chaosStar.description: Funny thing. Your target knows the person, but they've never heard your name mentioned. If you used Guile for the check, gain the Cowed condition while this card is recharging.

reckless.requirements: Target must be able to hear you, the person you mention must be important (a big name). This action can only be made against each individual target once per act. If you do not really know the subject of your name-drop, add {Dm} to the check and use Guile (Fel) vs. Target Intuition (Int) instead.
